agentName.title: Agent Name
agentName.description: The name of the Salesforce agent performing the work. Use CostPilot Agent when no more specific name is known.

department.title: Department
department.description: The business department responsible for this request when known from the record or conversation.

businessUnit.title: Business Unit
businessUnit.description: The business unit responsible for this request when known.

recordId.title: Record Id
recordId.description: The current Salesforce record ID when the request refers to this record, the current record, or information on the open page.

objectName.title: Object Name
objectName.description: The Salesforce object API name for the current record when known, such as Opportunity, Account, Case, Contact, or CostPilot_Project__c.

prompt.title: User Prompt
prompt.description: The complete AI request from the user. Preserve the user's requested task, format, quantity, audience, and other instructions.

contextJson.title: Context JSON
contextJson.description: Optional additional structured context already available to the agent. Do not ask the user to provide it.
